errors.evidence: The tick labels on the y-axis are at 20-unit intervals (20, 40, 60, 80), not 10-unit intervals.
The red line (Precision) starts at approximately 79% at 70m, not 72%.

Describing the trend of the red line (Precision) as a simple decrease is an over-generalization and incorrect. The line dips and then rises again, ending at a value (~77%) only slightly lower than its starting value. The statement misrepresents both the trend and the final value.
The red line (Precision) ends at approximately 77% at 7.0B, not 68%.
The blue line (Recall) increases to approximately 45% at 7.0B, not 33%.
The purple line (F1-score) ends at approximately 56% at 7.0B, not 51%.
